import os,glob,re, json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))

def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=g[0][0]
    # vertical line column: column where a single non-bg color runs full height
    line_col=line_col_val=None
    for j in range(w):
        col={g[i][j] for i in range(h)}
        if len(col)==1:
            v=col.pop()
            if v!=bg:
                line_col,line_col_val=j,v; break
    # shape: all other non-bg cells
    cells=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if g[i][j] not in (bg,line_col_val) and not (j==line_col)]
    sv=g[cells[0][0]][cells[0][1]]
    js=[j for _,j in cells]
    jmin,jmax=min(js),max(js)
    shift = (line_col - jmax - 1) if jmax < line_col else (line_col - jmin + 1)
    out=[[line_col_val if j==line_col else bg for j in range(w)] for i in range(h)]
    for i,j in cells:
        out[i][j+shift]=sv
